title: Ko te manawanui i kaha ake i te pouri
intro: He kaumātua i rongonui tōna manawanui, i memeha haere tōna tirohanga i te pouri, engari kāore i ngoikore tōna whakapono ki te mahere atua. I mātakitaki tēnei tangata i ngā tama tekau mā rua e tipu ake ana hei turanga mō ngā iwi, i mamae i te mate o tētahi tamaiti tino arohaina, ā, i riro hei tohu mutunga kore o te manawanui ataahua i te aroaro o te pouri nui. He wairua whakaute e kōrerotia ana tana kōrero puta noa i ngā whārangi o te whakakitenga. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata mai i te Quran?
clues: He poropiti ahau, ko tana kōrero taipitopito kei roto i tētahi o ngā surah nui o te Quran.
Tekau mā rua aku tama, ā, ko rātou ngā matua o ngā iwi o Bani Iharaira.
I mea atu ahau ki aku tama kia tomo mā ngā kēti rerekē, kei mōhiotia rātou he iwi kotahi.
I mā ōku kanohi i te tangi mutunga kore mō taku tamaiti e arohaina nei i tangohia i ahau.
I whakakahore ahau ki te ngakaukore ahakoa te akiaki a aku tama ki ahau kia pena, me te mea ko Allah anake taku e amuamu ai.
Ko ahau te matua o te poropiti a Yusuf, ko te tikanga o tōna ingoa tonu i roto i te reo Ārapi ko 'te kaiwhakanui'.

trial.answer: Te ngaromanga o te tama aroha ki te puna

outcome.label: Hua
options: I hoki mai te tirohanga i te wā i hipokina ai te mata o te hāte o tā rātou tama aroha
Te whakaoranga i muri i te makanga ki roto i te puku o te ika nui

Te whiti i te moana me te iwi kua wetekina i te herekore

outcome.answer: I hoki mai te tirohanga i te wā i hipokina ai te mata o te hāte o tā rātou tama aroha

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
